## 5. Uncertainty & Technical Limitations

1. **Spatial Resolution (10m GSD)**: Water bodies smaller than 0.1 hectares (~10 Sentinel-2 pixels) cannot be reliably resolved. Small agricultural farm ponds or narrow irrigation canals (<10m width) suffer sub-pixel mixed signal attenuation.
2. **Turbidity and Spectral Variation**: Sediment-rich waters reflect in green/red bands, which may lower MNDWI values. Aquatic vegetation or algal blooms reflect strongly in NIR, which pure water indices classify as vegetation.
3. **Attribution Neutrality**: This report presents verified surface water extent dynamics. Local fluctuations (such as irrigation inundation or riverbed sandbar shifts) are possible contributors (not verified) and must not be treated as confirmed causes without high-resolution field or aerial validation.
